items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He was trying to get the Duke Ellington sound, but Duke Ellington never used anything like that.

ctx.x: Stan Kenton. He was trying to get the Duke Ellington sound, but Duke Ellington never used anything like that.
See, Duke would use a mute -- plunger mute -- and trumpet. They'd tighten them up and blow. Open up just a little bit. Get that sound, you know. (humming notes)
